check.claim: PCSX2 boots Rez (USA) only with a PS2 BIOS image in its BIOS folder
check.method: The PCSX2 AppImage EmuDeck installs, with its BIOS folder holding nothing, then the US BIOS ps2-0230a-20080220.bin as the collection holds it. Each variant runs twice from a fresh data folder for 120 seconds under Xvfb with the software renderer and no input, the screen sampled every 2 seconds. The verdict comes from the oracle and PCSX2's own BIOS error strings.

result.statement: verdict is identical across all 2 variants

error_patterns: Unable\ to\ auto\ locate\ a\ BIOS\ image
